data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.7m (2016: GBP 1.9m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
primary_causes: reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 reported a net release of GBP 3.7 million in prior year reserves, representing a 14.18% reduction relative to its net opening claims outstanding. This release is attributed to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
raw_causal_phrases: reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development of GBP 3.7 million is explicitly stated as a net surplus in the narrative. The percentage is calculated against the net opening claims provision for 2017, which is GBP 26.086 million (from page 28).
